need.capability: A market data infrastructure layer providing clean historical OHLCV data, accurate machine-readable corporate actions, index compositions, real-time/delayed feeds, and mutual fund NAVs.
need.business_context: A Series A fintech startup building an institutional-grade portfolio analytics and compliance platform for Indian wealth managers (boutiques, family offices, and RIAs).
need.problem: Unadjusted or inaccurate corporate action historical data leads to incorrect IRR and P&L calculations, creating legal liability risks. Additionally, obtaining legally compliant, authorized exchange feeds to avoid unauthorized scraping is difficult and costly.

intent.rationale: The market data feed serves as the critical underlying plumbing and raw material that enables the startup's core portfolio analytics and compliance calculations.

resources.budget_note: Can spend ₹3–5 lakh per month (~$3,600–6,000/month) at launch, scaling to ₹8–10 lakh/month (~$9,600–12,000/month). Bloomberg is out of scope.
resources.runway_note: Series A funded with ~$3.2M raised and 22 months of runway.

compliance: SEBI Research Analyst and Investment Advisor regulations
Exchange authorization for market data redistribution (NSE/BSE)
constraints.data_sensitivity: Price data is not sensitive, but client portfolio data mapped to prices is. Need to know if vendors train models on ingested data or have strict data processing agreements.
constraints.timeline_hard_stop: 4 weeks to have historical OHLCV and corporate actions working in staging before wealth manager onboarding begins in week 6.

soft_steer: Data quality, accuracy, regulatory licensing, and avoiding proprietary vendor lock-in with portable APIs matter most, even if it requires a premium over cut-rate, unlicenced feeds.
